body: Layering is enforced by internal/archtest: `provider` is stdlib-only; provider/claude and provider/codex import provider + stdlib; config, secret, pick, sessions, login are public libraries (no CLI concerns); internal/cli is the ONLY package importing cobra or voltkit command modules. Everything outside internal/ is an importable library. archtest was verified by adding a forbidden import inside a multi-line import block (3 violations reported).
